title: Augustine's Tractates on the Gospel of John
author: Augustine of Hippo
license: Public domain (John Gibb translation, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 7, 1888)
description: Selected passage-keyed chapters from Augustine's Tractates on the Gospel of John, using the John Gibb translation in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, volume 7 (1888). One verified tractate excerpt is included for each of John chapters 1–21; this does not claim to cover every verse or all 124 tractates.
attribution: Augustine of Hippo, Tractates on the Gospel of John, translated by John Gibb, in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 7, edited by Philip Schaff (1888), public-domain edition
